settings.heading: Modes
settings.row_content:
Short Clean Cycle (5 Minutes)

  • Purpose: Designed for delicate items such as retainers, aligners, and other soft dental appliances. Temperatures can reach up to 55°C.
  • How to Use:
     • Ensure the device is in standby mode (white ring light). Pour clean room temperature water
    • Short press the main power button once — the ring light will turn blue, indicating the 5-minute cycle has started.
    • Allow at least 30 minutes between cycles to prevent overheating.
  • Key Benefit: Offers a gentle clean to help remove debris and surface build-up without risking heat damage to soft plastics.

Long Clean Cycle (10 Minutes)

  • Purpose: Recommended for more durable items such as metal jewellery or keys
  • How to Use:
     • From standby mode (white ring light), press and hold the main power button — the ring light will flash blue, indicating the 10-minute cycle has started. Temperatures can reach up to 60°C.
    • Avoid using this mode for plastic or heat-sensitive items. Let the device cool fully between cycles - at least 30 minutes.
  • Key Benefit: Provides a deeper clean for tougher, solid items that can tolerate extended exposure to warm water.

UV Sterilisation Mode

  • Purpose: Adds an extra sterilisation step using UV light to support hygiene.
    How to Use:
     • After the cleaning cycle ends, press the button on the top of the lid.
    • The button will light green to indicate the UV mode is active.
    • UV only activates when the lid is closed and the lights are facing downward.
  • Key Benefit: Enhances cleanliness by introducing UV sterilisation to help reduce surface-level bacteria.

settings.heading: Cautions
settings.row_content:
IMPORTANT:Please read and follow all instructions carefully. Failure to follow these guidelines can cause the device to overheat. Internal temperatures may rise close to 60°C, potentially damaging your dental appliances.

Do not use corrosive or hot liquids for cleaning.

Avoid exposing the UV light directly to your skin or eyes.

Aligners, retainers, and veneers may warp or discolour under these temperatures. Check with your dentist before use. We are not liable for damage to heat-sensitive items.

Use clean water for each cycle to ensure optimal results.

Use room temperature water 20 - 22°C.

Allow the device to cool down for at least 30 minutes between uses to prevent overheating.

Store the device in a dry, cool place after use for longevity.

settings.heading: Instructions & Tips
settings.row_content:
1. Fill the tank with clean water and add the cleaning tablet.

2. Place your dental appliance inside the tank.

3. Press the power button to start the ultrasonic cleaning.

4. Wait 5 minutes for the cleaning and UV sterilisation to complete.

5. Remove the appliance, rinse with water, and dry the device.

settings.heading: Can the Water Flosser Pro be used on composite bonding, veneers or fillings?
settings.row_content: Yes, the Water Flosser Pro is suitable for use on composite bonding, veneers, and fillings. This device is designed to provide a thorough yet gentle clean, effectively removing plaque and debris from between your teeth and around dental restorations. It’s safe to use on all types of dental work, helping you maintain optimal oral hygiene without compromising the integrity of your composite bonding, veneers, or fillings.
